name: story-vlog
label: Story vlog / serial challenge (Ryan Trahan-style)
description: Earnest serialized challenge diary: one-line rules, named recurring segments, running counter, a heart moment, cliffhanger to the next episode.

sync.broll: establishing shots between locations, time-lapse on 'later that day', receipts/screens as PiP; ~80:20
sync.fillers: comedic cutaway that proves/contradicts the line every 20-40 s, freeze + label on introductions, counter graphics
sync.music: soft bed under talk, cut out for jokes and heartfelt lines, swell on the win, montages on the beat
sync.emotion_map: amusement → curiosity → anxiety (music drops, ambience only) → warmth (acoustic swell) → pride → anticipation
sync.transitions: hard cuts, location title cards, time-lapse bridges

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: no body shaming or before/after transformations
supplement claims only in label-approved wording
health brands: staff-led challenges only, no patient journeys (testimonial)
